purpose: Metadata-only source audit for the first independent Himalayan-glacier validation pair. This file records geometry-source leads; it does not freeze an AOI, product list, or scientific result.

execution_boundary.reason: Exact source AOI/product timing has not been recovered from the reviewed IIRS article text. Geometry and acquisition identity must be frozen before query/scoring.

primary_reference.title: NISAR for Monitoring Glacier Motion
primary_reference.comparator_limit: The source compares a single NISAR acquisition pair with multi-year/multi-sensor ITS_LIVE. Published ranges are not a pixelwise truth set and do not establish a single universal error tolerance.

inventory_source.name: Randolph Glacier Inventory (RGI)
inventory_source.temporal_warning: RGI is an inventory snapshot targeted around year 2000; RGI 7.0 region 14 was replaced by GAMDAM/GGI18 outlines primarily mapped from summer Landsat scenes around 2002. Do not present these as date-matched January 2026 glacier boundaries.

freeze_gates: Acquire the official RGI 7.0 Region 14 source package or an independently verifiable mirror; record archive bytes and SHA-256.
Resolve the Samudra Tapu RGI 7 identifier from source attributes/link table; do not infer it from the RGI 6 ID.
Extract each polygon, validate topology and CRS, preserve the unmodified source outline, and record canonical geometry bytes/hash plus extraction code revision.
Label these AOIs as independent inventory-outline ROIs. Do not assert they are the IIRS authors' analysis masks.
Recover exact NISAR pair IDs and dates and a pinned ITS_LIVE product/version before any quantitative comparison.
Keep raw-source downloads and scored validation behind the existing explicit consent/control workflow.

references.use: Reported ranges and January 2026 temporal label
